meta.why: authorisation is the exact token in D-270's decision status plus this file's unspent entries, never a general boolean

budget.separateFrom: every earlier budget (D-255, D-258, D-267 and the rest)
budget.enforcedLimit: the call count (one one-shot claim per call); the price is an estimate

price.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (Standard, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst: text input $5.00, image input $8.00, image output $30.00 per 1M tokens; no per-image price is given)
price.basis: no image input; about 300 text tokens in per prompt ($0.0015); 1,756 image output tokens as measured for 1024x1024 high on D-267's TMG-1 and TMG-2 ($0.0527)
price.note: an estimate, not a guaranteed maximum; the billed amount is read on the OpenAI usage page

privacy.cSentToApi: never: no image and no reference is sent
privacy.publishOrTrack: never: the raw results and every review sheet stay outside both clones (D-127 §2)

frozen.production: d240 (unchanged; this is not the production method)

stopRules: three single calls: no retry, no reserve, no fallback, no replacement call, no other model
uncertain dispatch: DISPATCHED_RESULT_UNKNOWN, NOT_DISPATCHED, RESPONSE_BODY_UNREADABLE, UNEXPECTED, or a claim without a written outcome — never resent, and no later call is sent
an HTTP error (credit, access, moderation or request shape) on any call stops every later call
a format reject at receipt (TECHNICAL_REJECT) does not stop the later calls; the deliveries are independent
